issue.title: Remove 2.2.0-beta.1 from bintray
issue.body:
https://bintray.com/szczepiq/maven/mockito/2.2.0-beta.1# was incorrectly generated by the delivery drone and must be removed asap from Bintray. Within 24 hours this is still possible, see https://bintray.com/docs/usermanual/uploads/uploads_deletingcontent.html

Only @szczepiq can do this because it is his account and not the Mockito organization.
